summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong Exchange rules, disclosing a share repurchase of 507,900 Class A ordinary shares on 22 May 2026 at HKD 19.6773 per share, representing ~0.054% of pre-existing issued shares. The repurchased shares are held as treasury, increasing treasury shares to 29,736,256. The board confirmed compliance with listing rules and no shares were cancelled. The filing serves as timely disclosure of an issuer buyback on the HKEX; typical procedural notice, not a formal tender offer. Watch for future buyback frequency and potential cancellation vs. reissuance.
